overview: This Senate resolution cheers on the U.S. Olympic and Paralympic teams at the 2026 Winter Games in Milan and Cortina, Italy. It applauds the athletes, coaches and their families, thanks Italy and its regional and local governments for working to provide a safe environment for the Games, and commits to keeping fans and athletes safe at the 2028 Summer Games in Los Angeles (with events in Oklahoma City) and the 2034 Winter Games in Utah. The Senate approved it on February 25, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes the hard work of American athletes and affirms the country's commitment to hosting safe Games in 2028 and 2034.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or provide any funding, including for the security it promises for future Games.
